name: Mojo Dojo Multiply
summary: Mojo Dojo Multiply is an interactive educational video game built with TypeScript. The project was created as part of a team for my Software Engineering course and focuses on helping users practice multiplication through engaging gameplay mechanics.
contributions: Developed an educational video game using TypeScript.
Designed gameplay systems to reinforce multiplication skills.
Collaborated with a team using version control and team workflows.

name: Spoilage
summary: Spoilage is a hybrid cozy and horror cooking simulation game developed in Unity with the UCSD Video Game Development Club. The project combines resource management with horror elements to create a unique gameplay experience.
role: I helped develop the Drag-N-Drop system, Cooking (pan & pot), and the Spoiling (people and food) System.
contributions: Collaborated with a game development team using Unity and C#.
Contributed to gameplay systems, mechanics, and feature development.
Worked with version control, coordination, and iterative development.
release: Will be out on Steam as of TBD.

name: Elevate
type: Online Task Management and Wardrobe App
summary: Elevate is a mobile-first productivity app that combines task management with a digital wardrobe system. The app helps users plan their schedules and generate outfit combinations from their own clothing pieces.
contributions: Developing core productivity and wardrobe planning features.
Designing recurring tasks, notifications, and clothing categorization.
Building a swipe-based outfit recommendation interface.
Will be implementing a React Native element for user interaction and a backend database storage system.

name: UnNamed
summary: UnNamed is a story-driven 3D game that combines action mechanics with narrative decision-making. The project focuses on immersive environments, combat systems, and branching story paths.
contributions: Developing a 3D action game with story-driven gameplay.
Implementing player progression, combat mechanics, and branching choices.
Using game design principles to create immersive environments.
